"This act of sabotage was deliberately designed to disable the station ... disrupting internet access for various institutions, including the Ukrainian army," Gawkowski, who also serves as digital minister, told public broadcaster TVP. He said the fire at the station belonging to Polish state-owned telecom company Exatel broke out late on Wednesday. "There is much to suggest that we are dealing with an element of the next phase of hybrid warfare," he said. The deputy premier said that the station was used to transmit internet traffic through Poland, including to neighboring Ukraine . He also said there were "many indications" suggesting the incident "fits into this new Russian doctrine of attack." "We ⁠expect our allies to step up," he said. The call is nothing new. As warnings about the threat emanating from Russia increase, and Washington demands European allies take greater responsibility for security, NATO has raised its target for defense spending from 2% to 3.5% of GDP, and pressure on those lagging is rising. stories.title: El Niño transforms Atacama desert as thousands of hectares burst into bloom
stories.summary: Exceptionally heavy El Niño rains have awakened millions of seeds lying dormant underground, carpeting vast swathes of one of the planet's driest places with flowers.

stories.title: Lucas Museum opens in Los Angeles with Star Wars treasures on display

stories.title: Pope Leo XIV gets the latte art treatment ahead of Latin America visit

stories.title: Watch: Six-year-old girl breaks women’s Rubik’s Cube world record
stories.summary: Six-year-old Chinese speedcuber Lian Yunzhi broke the women’s 3x3 Rubik’s Cube world record twice in just three days, setting an average time of 4.27 seconds.
